reconstruction_fits.reading_rule: Residuals are standardized mean and second-moment errors under independently refined positive quadrature. Counts include cache reuse, repeated validations and rejected trial stages, not independent fits or physical events. Warm-start and fallback counts describe the cached fit used for each reconstruction. Optimizer stalls are admitted only by the unchanged moment and normalization-refinement criterion.

reconstruction_roundoff.reading_rule: Bounds use the number and mass units of this grid; counts include repeated validations and rejected trial stages, not independent physical events. Stored populations and moments are unchanged. Positive bounds are rounded upward when converted to float.

semigroup_control.reading_rule: One update versus two half updates at the crossing. Any difference includes intermediate reconstruction; the underlying constant-rate transition has the exact semigroup property.

evidence: Numerical maintained-bath capture controls. No closed aggregation, moisture depletion, full lunar column or empirical snow validation.
reading_rule: Distribution, moments, accounting and truncation are separate gates. Analytical tail and finite-ladder bounds exclude reconstruction, source quadrature and floating-point errors. Physical exits stop at first crossing. Poisson controls sample each grid at its own first face; the initial 191-cell setting matches the earlier crossing. The physical reference uses 8192 independent event histories and unbiased sample variance. Its 95% DKW band is uniform in mass at each time separately, not joint across controls or a numerical convergence bound.
